provenance.title: Light levels
provenance.covers: How bright each room type should be and how many ceiling lights that takes. Common rules of thumb from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document L: Conservation of fuel and power (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
